rounds.report:
Representation level: L1 (proxy). This is the CineRecon Three.js sampled-frame baseline, not a reproduction of Blender model rankings.

Observed from the 24 reference samples (0-23.97 s, 1280x720, 30 fps, 720 frames): one continuous shot with no cuts. A drone orbits a stationary woman (white top, dark trousers, long dark hair) who stands on a bare dirt patch in a dry golden field. A small tan dog sits about 1 m from her beside a thin post. Background items move to the right across the frame, and the dog moves from image-right of her (about 1-12 s), to in front of her (about 13.5 s), to image-left (about 15-22 s), and is hidden behind her at 0 s and 24 s. From this I conclude the camera strafes to its right and yaws left through roughly 355 degrees in the 24 s. The woman holds a controller at her chest. She raises her right arm (image-left) at about 3-6.6 s and 18.6-20 s, extends it to the side at about 21.9 s, brings both hands to her face at about 22.9 s, and waves it up and out at about 24 s. Landmarks in the samples: the treeline around the clearing, a low grassy berm, a picnic shelter, a sign board, a rock mound and brush piles. The low sun is backlit at about 15-19 s, and tree shadows cross the foreground at about 0-12 s.

Geometry: the woman is built from cylinders, boxes and spheres: legs, torso, head, a hair cap and back, and two arms. Each arm has a shoulder and elbow joint with two degrees of freedom each, and there is a controller box in her left hand. The dog is a sitting proxy made from spheres, boxes and cylinders. The post is a thin cylinder. The environment uses a noise-textured ground plane, an ellipsoid berm, a ring of cone and sphere trees with a continuous dark forest wall behind them, a box-and-pyramid shelter, a box sign, and ellipsoid rock and brush piles. The sky is a vertex-coloured gradient dome with a sun disc and an additive glow sprite (procedural). Tree, figure and dirt-patch shadows are flat translucent decals.

Camera: PerspectiveCamera with a 50 degree vertical FOV. Orbit radius 15.2 m, height 3.3 m, always looking at the woman's centre (0.85 m). The orbit angle is a monotone cubic spline keyed at the sample times (0, 24, 61, 103, 155, 214, 274, 327, 355 degrees), estimated from background parallax and dog/woman occlusion.

Timing and articulation: arm poses are keyframed with smoothstep blends at the times listed above, and there is a small wave oscillation while the arm is raised high. The woman turns continuously to face the drone. Every pose is computed absolutely from time.

Inference, not observed: motion between samples, the exact orbit rate, landmark distances (derived from parallax), the dog's facing, and the woman's exact facing at every moment.

Render feedback: none received yet (initial generation).
